text:
alex: Customer reported 403 when accepting a project invite right after their Okta OIDC attribute rename. They claim they have project Admin role in IdP but console shows "You don't have permission". Details:
alex: curl call returns 403 with header `x-auth-reason: no-project-role`, token scopes look fine.
alex: attaching reproducible curl we ran:
alex: ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token_from_okta>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/1234/actions/accept-invite
# -> 403 {"error":"forbidden","message":"no project role"}
```
mira: any chance their SCIM/group claim got renamed? we saw a tenant rename earlier today.
jordan: customer said Okta renamed `groups` -> `team_groups` in their OIDC claims during a rollout at 09:10 UTC.
alex: yep timeline matches. invite accepted at 09:22 and failed.
mira: sounds like role mapping pipeline uses `groups` claim to populate project roles. if it's missing we treat user as no-role.
sre-bot: Note: identity-sync job `idp-sync-01` last successful run 1768455600, next run at 1768462000 (scheduled). immediate re-sync not automatic on attribute rename.
customer-success: customer urgently needs write access for product demo in 30m. they asked for workaround.
mira: workaround: manual role bind via console by org-admin, or customer can accept invite using a token scoped to org-admin (not ideal). we can also trigger a manual idp sync from support side: `POST /internal/idp/sync?tenant=acme` (requires admin token)
alex: did manual rebind for them — created project role for user `u:okta:john.doe` -> project:editor at 09:40 UTC. customer confirmed access restored.
jordan: long-term fix: update OIDC mapping logic to accept `team_groups` alias and fallback on other claim names. filing eng issue.
mira: created ticket INF-2048 with repro steps, logs, and the Okta claim sample. assigned to eng-identity @jordan.
alex: also adding a short doc blurb to troubleshooting: "403 after IdP attribute rename -> check claim names and run manual IDP sync".
idp-team-bot: FYI Okta rollout notes: we pushed claim rename to several customers 09:00-09:30 UTC, will coordinate future rename windows.
jordan: next steps: 1) hotfix to accept alias claims (patch planned for next deploy), 2) add a healthcheck alert when idp-sync sees unknown claim names, 3) add support tool to trigger on-demand idp-sync.
alex: thanks — marking thread resolved for support, leaving eng ticket open. :thumbsup:
